interface.shortDescription: ModernUO and Ultima Online development guidance for RebirthUO.
interface.longDescription: ModernUO is a 1:1 plugin mirror of the Hermes profile skills used for Ultima Online, ModernUO, and RebirthUO work. It provides source-synced guidance for RebirthUO server development, including codebase navigation, issue implementation, issue triage and online verification, implementation and human-review plans, canonical game-doc authoring, test workflow and regression testing, migration guidance, cross-era change routing, LootPack source preservation, symbol and naming discipline, performance and lifecycle reviews, named Ultima Online skill, spell, and item-property parity checks, evidence-backed era parity reports with expected-vs-actual data deltas, content taxonomy, subsystem audits, serialization, timers, networking, regions, combat, crafting, loot, quests, housing, skills, stats, and related Ultima Online domain research.
